reference_text: No added sugar. Sounds like sugar-free... right? Well... not quite. Fruit juice can still contain sugar from the fruit. So turn the pack over. Check total sugars, then compare similar drinks per hundred millilitres. Small flip. Better information.
script: In two thousand nine, some young scientists called fifteen detox brands.
Two questions. What does detox mean? And where's the proof?
No two brands meant the same thing. Most had no proof.
And one of them... was a hair straightener.
Detox teas are no different. Often, it's senna. A laxative. You lose water, not toxins.
The real detox? Your liver and kidneys. No straightener required.
